end.parentNote: Dev practised identifying circle parts and relating radius, diameter and chords. They correctly used the fact that only a diameter passes through the centre and that the diameter is twice the radius. Dev mixed up a sector and a segment, and continued to say that a circle has only two or four lines of symmetry; these were not corrected by the end. At home, use a labelled circle diagram and ask Dev to shade one sector and one segment, then draw several lines through the centre as lines of symmetry.
